/.title: Oil Find：苹果版的 Everything，免费开源的 Mac 文件搜索工具
/.description: 按 ⇧⌘F，屏幕正中弹出搜索框，每敲一个键不到 10 毫秒出结果。支持拼音首字母、通配符、正则和实时更新，不依赖 Spotlight。免费开源，Pro 还能搜外置硬盘，以及图片和文档里的文字。

/en.title: Oil Find: Everything for Mac, a free and open-source file search app
/en.description: Press ⇧⌘F and results appear with every keystroke, in under 10 ms. Wildcards, regex, pinyin and live updates, without Spotlight. Free and open source; Pro adds external drives and search inside images and documents.

/pro.title: Oil Find Pro：搜外置硬盘，以及图片和文档里的文字
/pro.description: 外置硬盘插上就建立索引，拔掉后也能搜到；截图、照片里的文字与画面，PDF、Word 等文档里的文字也能搜，全部在本机处理。¥49 一次买断，可以免费试用 7 天。

/en/pro.title: Oil Find Pro: search external drives and the text inside images and documents
/en/pro.description: Drives stay searchable after you unplug them, and you can search the text in your screenshots, photos, PDFs and Office documents, all processed on your Mac. $9.99 once, with a 7-day free trial.

zh.q: 和 Spotlight 有什么不同
zh.a: Spotlight 同时搜文件内容、应用和网页，结果多，排序难以预料。Oil Find 只按文件名找，自己维护一份内存索引，每敲一个键都在 10 毫秒内出结果，还支持拼音首字母、通配符和正则。
和 Windows 上的 Everything 思路一样：给磁盘上的文件名建一份索引，输入即出结果。Everything 只有 Windows 版，Oil Find 是为 Mac 写的原生应用。

en.a: Spotlight searches file contents, apps and the web at once, so results are many and their order is hard to predict. Oil Find finds files by name only, keeps its own in-memory index and answers every keystroke in under 10 ms, with pinyin initials, wildcards and regex.
It works like Everything on Windows: an index of every file name on your disk, with results as you type. Everything is Windows-only; Oil Find is a native Mac app.

privacy.zh: 免费版只索引文件名，不读文件内容；Pro 识别图片、读取文档也全部在这台 Mac 上完成。索引只存在本机。每天检查一次更新，只读取版本信息。
privacy.en: The free version indexes file names only, never file contents, and Pro reads images and documents entirely on your Mac. The index stays on this Mac. Oil Find checks for updates once a day and only reads version info.
